preconditions.description: The number of intersections n is between 1 and 200,000.
The length of the list a is equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(i <= a[i-1] <= n for i in range(1, n+1))
preconditions.description: For each intersection i, the shortcut a_i satisfies i <= a_i <= n.

preconditions.expression: all(a[i-1] <= a[i] for i in range(1, n))

postconditions.description: The output list m has exactly n elements.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(m[i], int) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each element in the output list m is an integer.
The minimum energy to reach intersection 1 is 0.
The minimum energy to reach any intersection is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(m[i] <= i for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The minimum energy to reach intersection i is at most i.
